title: NASA: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 5:35 PM
text:
Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 5:35 PM
2h
Join us for NASA astronaut Anil Menon and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk’s next spacewalk!
Tune in on Thursday, Nov. 5, to watch the two astronauts step back outside the International Space Station. During this spacewalk, which will start around 8:30 a.m. EST (1330 UTC) and run for about six-and-a-half hours, the pair will install and deploy another new solar array on the orbiting lab. https://youtube.com/live/25JEQqgv5I4 See less
